name: lc-national-insurance
description: Saint Lucia National Insurance Corporation contribution reference checked for 2026. Covers ordinary employee and employer contributions, the monthly earnings ceiling, insurable-pay inclusions and exclusions, monthly remittance timing and worked payroll examples. Use for Saint Lucia NIC deductions, employer contributions or gross earnings for social insurance. It distinguishes the contribution base from income-tax pay and treats multiple-employer refunds separately from routine payroll deductions. The scope assumes covered employment has been established. Benefits, reciprocal agreements, partial-month rules, age transitions and the self-employed assessment framework need separate review. This source-cited draft has no accountant attestation.
